answer: Make each agent post a refundable stake that is slashed when peers prove fake work, so minting thousands of identities means locking real capital per identity, not free copies. New agents earn weight slowly: their attestations count only after independent verifiers confirm sustained useful work over several epochs, like water carving a karst valley grain by grain. One ember of reputation cannot be mass-produced, and a sonnet of borrowed credentials fails when verifiers demand fresh costly proof tied to a single key. Sybil farms must then pay linearly per fake or stay harmlessly small.
